line.name: E.P. Carrillo Battleborn
line.background_text: Marketed as 'Perez-Carrillo Battleborn,' this limited-edition line honors Lionel H. McKoy, a U.S. Navy Gulf War veteran who joined Casa Carrillo as shipping manager in 2017. Ernesto Perez-Carrillo III created the line after McKoy shared his military story with him; proceeds support veteran and first-responder charities including the Fisher House Foundation.

vitolas.summary_review: Cigar Coop rated it 88; solid but described as lacking a 'thrilling factor' despite good construction.

critic_reviews.key_notes_text: Coffee, earth, lemon peel dominant; medium to medium-full strength; 'Try a Sample' at $22.

research_notes: Limited to 2,500 individually numbered boxes of 20, $22/cigar. Only one vitola confirmed.

research_sources.supports: review score, tasting notes, strength, blend
